name: confessions
description: Test vectors for /confessions anonymous board per spec 18.10. Derived from RFC 8428 SenML, RFC 7252 CoAP, RFC 8613 OSCORE. No LICHEN implementation used as oracle. Covers all 5 required scenarios: (1) anonymous confession default, (2) OSCORE-protected group confession, (3) rate-limit boundary, (4) storage-full eviction, (5) reboot clear.

vectors.name: anonymous_confession_default
vectors.description: Anonymous confession POST with full SenML payload per 18.10.1. Default anonymous=1, location optional, TTL 12h (43200s). Oracle: RFC 8428 SenML-CBOR encoding rules.

senml_json.vs: Left the forward operating base unlocked at 0200. Nobody noticed.

vectors.name: anonymous_confession_minimal
vectors.description: Minimal anonymous confession with only required fields: type and content. No location, default anonymous=true implicit, default TTL applied by receiver.

vectors.name: non_anonymous_confession
vectors.description: Non-anonymous confession with anonymous=0, includes sender field. Per 18.10.1, implementations MAY reject, accept, or require operator privilege.

senml_json.vs: I fixed the radio but forgot to log it.

vectors.name: oscore_group_confession
vectors.description: OSCORE-protected group confession per 18.10.5. Uses group OSCORE context for sender unlinkability. Receiver knows sender is in group but not which member. RECOMMENDED mode for confessions.

expected.note: Sender IID masked via group context

vectors.name: oscore_pairwise_confession_privacy_warning
vectors.description: OSCORE with pairwise context reveals sender identity to receiver. Per 18.10.5, this may be undesirable for confessions. Test documents the privacy tradeoff.

oscore_context.note: Pairwise reveals sender - use group context instead

expected.privacy_warning: Pairwise OSCORE reveals sender to receiver

vectors.name: rate_limit_12th_post_accepted
vectors.description: 12th POST within rolling hour (at hourly limit) is accepted. Per 18.10.3, hourly limit is 12 POSTs per node.

senml_json.vs: This is my twelfth confession this hour.

vectors.name: rate_limit_13th_post_rejected
vectors.description: 13th POST within rolling hour exceeds hourly limit. Returns 4.29 Too Many Requests with Retry-After.

vectors.name: rate_limit_30s_window
vectors.description: Second POST within 30 seconds rejected (tightest LICHEN rate limit). Per 18.10.3, 1 POST per 30s per node.

vectors.name: storage_full_fifo_eviction
vectors.description: When total storage is full (2KB leaf, 8KB BR), oldest confessions evicted FIFO. Per 18.10.3, no back-pressure signaling - old confessions silently vanish.

expected.note: Old confessions silently evicted to make room

vectors.name: storage_full_br_larger_budget
vectors.description: Border router has 8KB storage budget vs 2KB for leaf. Tests larger capacity.

vectors.name: reboot_clear_empty_get
vectors.description: GET /confessions after reboot returns empty list. Per 18.10.4, confessions are RAM-only and cleared on any reboot (warm/cold/crash).

vectors.name: reboot_clear_crash
vectors.description: GET /confessions after crash reboot returns empty. Crash reboot also clears RAM-only storage.

vectors.name: get_confessions_with_metadata
vectors.description: GET /confessions?count=5 returns confessions with rate limit and storage metadata per 18.10.7.

vectors.name: max_confession_size_accepted
vectors.description: Confession at max size (768 bytes) is accepted. Per 18.10.3, max confession size is 768B.

vectors.name: max_confession_size_exceeded
vectors.description: Confession exceeding 768 bytes is rejected with 4.13 Request Entity Too Large.

vectors.name: ttl_expiry
vectors.description: Confession with TTL expired is not returned in GET. Default retention 12h, max 48h per 18.10.3.

vectors.name: no_log_guarantee_checks
vectors.description: Compliance checks for no-log guarantee per 18.10.4. Implementation MUST NOT persist to flash/NVS/filesystem, log to /sos/log or /msg/sent, include in beacons, or persist OSCORE context info.
